about.title: About This Site
about.intro: A personal civic tech knowledge base built by Claire, open to the public. Every day it automatically collects articles from 17 global media outlets and research organisations, translates them via AI, and presents daily summaries in Traditional Chinese.
about.jtbdTitle: What problems does this site solve?
about.job1When: I want to follow global civic tech developments, but don't have time to read a dozen English-language sources every day
about.job1Want: spend five minutes each morning reading today's digest and staying on top of key global developments
about.job1So: efficiently maintain awareness of global civic tech trends without missing important news due to language barriers
about.job2When: I'm writing a newsletter or article and need international case studies to support my points
about.job2Want: quickly search for cases by country or topic and find compelling international examples
about.job2So: produce more substantive writing while saving time that would otherwise be spent searching raw sources
about.job3When: I'm planning a civic tech project or policy proposal and want to understand what other countries are doing
about.job3Want: browse cases by region and topic using the map and tag filters
about.job3So: discover innovative practices I wouldn't otherwise know about, and use them as inspiration
about.step1: Every day at 08:00 (Taiwan time), articles are automatically fetched from 17 RSS sources
about.step2: DeepL API translates titles and content snippets into Traditional Chinese
about.step3: Claude AI generates Chinese and English summaries and assigns topic tags
about.step4: Articles are compiled into a daily digest report, with an audio version generated
about.sourcesDesc: Currently tracking 17 media outlets and research organisations from the UK, US, Australia, and international bodies — updated daily.
about.updateDesc: Automatically updated every day at 08:00 Taiwan time (scheduled via GitHub Actions). The database stores only AI-translated summaries; please visit the original source websites to read full articles.
